stories.title: Deadly Houthi Attacks on Riyadh Airport Leave 12 Dead and Hundreds Injured
stories.summary: A series of attacks attributed to the Iran-backed Houthi militia targeted Riyadh's international airport, resulting in at least 12 fatalities and over 300 injuries. The Saudi-led coalition has condemned the strikes as a 'war crime' and vowed a decisive response. Following the initial attack, a second projectile struck the airport, causing further damage and prompting the closure of the facility and the transition of local schools to online learning.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV to Undergo Lung Surgery for Early-Stage Nodule
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV has announced that he will undergo surgery this week to remove a localized nodule found in his lung. The pontiff stated that the nodule was detected at a very early stage. He informed the public during his weekly blessing at St. Peter's Square.

stories.title: Trump Announces Energy Ceasefire Between Russia and Ukraine
stories.summary: President Donald Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an 'energy ceasefire' amid ongoing tensions. However, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy expressed skepticism, stating that this was 'news for me' and indicated that Ukraine would halt strikes on Russian oil refineries only if Russia ceased its attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Trump's comments have drawn criticism, particularly regarding his previous remarks about Ukraine's leadership.

stories.title: Tragic Capsizing of Migrant Boat off Djibouti Leaves 139 Dead and 84 Missing
stories.summary: A migrant boat capsized off the coast of Djibouti, resulting in at least 139 confirmed deaths, including 15 children. The International Organization for Migration reported that 84 individuals remain missing, while 82 survivors, all Ethiopian nationals, have been accounted for. The vessel was reportedly carrying over 300 people en route to Yemen when the incident occurred.

stories.title: Justice Department Investigates TV Networks Over Trump Press Pool Suspension
stories.summary: The U.S. Justice Department is investigating whether five major television networks violated antitrust laws by temporarily suspending their coverage of President Trump. This action followed the White House's decision to revoke credentials from three news organizations, including CNN. The networks involved in the investigation are ABC, CBS, CNN, NBC, and Fox News.

stories.title: Hurricane Simon Strengthens to Category 4, Approaching Mexico's Pacific Coast
stories.summary: Hurricane Simon has intensified into a powerful Category 4 storm with maximum sustained winds of 155 mph. The storm is currently located off the Pacific coast of Mexico and is expected to make landfall or closely approach the coast later today, posing threats of destructive winds, storm surges, and flooding.

stories.title: Flash Floods Prompt Evacuations in Northern Nepal
stories.summary: Residents in northern Nepal have evacuated their villages due to flash flooding from the Budhi Gandaki River. The floods have reportedly swept away several buildings and bridges, exacerbating the situation in an area already affected by previous catastrophic floods two months prior.

stories.title: Navi Pillay Awarded Nobel Peace Prize for Advocacy of International Law
stories.summary: Navi Pillay, a South African jurist and former UN human rights chief, has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her extensive work in promoting international law and human rights. The Nobel Committee recognized her efforts, particularly her role in leading a UN commission that found Israel guilty of genocide in Gaza. The award comes amid increasing political attacks on international legal institutions, coinciding with recent sanctions imposed by the Trump administration on the International Criminal Court, where Pillay serves as a judge.

stories.title: Panama Issues State of Emergency Amid Ongoing Aftershocks from Recent Earthquakes
stories.summary: Panama's government declared a state of emergency following two significant earthquakes, measuring 7.7 and 6.6 in magnitude, that struck the country. The quakes triggered over 100 aftershocks, with the strongest reaching 5.8. While no fatalities have been reported, damage has been noted across all 10 provinces and two Indigenous territories.

stories.title: Protests in India Lead to Detentions Amid Calls for Election Chief's Resignation
stories.summary: In Delhi, police detained hundreds of protesters for the second consecutive day as they demanded the resignation of India's election chief. The protests coincided with a court decision that resulted in the release of Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the 'cockroach' movement, along with two other senior leaders.

stories.title: Trump Criticizes Zelenskyy, Suggests Ukraine Needs New Leadership
stories.summary: Donald Trump has criticized Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, suggesting that Ukraine should elect a new president. He blamed Zelenskyy for rising US diesel prices and criticized his failure to negotiate a peace deal with Russia. Trump also cautioned Ukraine against targeting Russian oil refineries that supply diesel fuel to the US.
